stem.text: The reaction $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{Br} + \text{OH}^{-} \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH} + \text{Br}^{-}$ proceeds via an $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ mechanism.
The reaction $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CBr} + \text{OH}^{-} \rightarrow (\text{CH}_3)_3\text{COH} + \text{Br}^{-}$ proceeds via an $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ mechanism.
Which statement about these two reactions is correct?

A.text: Both reactions involve homolytic bond fission.

B.text: Both reactions involve hydroxide ions acting as electron pair donors.

C.text: Both reactions involve the formation of a positively-charged intermediate.

D.text: Both reactions occur in a single step.
